cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(motd-kokoro-host LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
if(NOT EXISTS "${MOTD_SHERPA_SOURCE}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Provide the checked Sherpa source tree")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${MOTD_SHERPA_SOURCE}" sherpa-source)
add_executable(motd-kokoro-smoke kokoro-smoke.cc)
target_include_directories(motd-kokoro-smoke PRIVATE "${MOTD_SHERPA_SOURCE}")
target_link_libraries(motd-kokoro-smoke PRIVATE sherpa-onnx-core)
